## Games

### Hamburg Towers Win Thrilling 91:87 Match in Jena

*Played Monday, 09 November 2026*

The Veolia Towers Hamburg secured a crucial 91:87 win over Science City Jena in a closely contested match. Mathys Kangudia led the Hamburg team with 24 points, including a decisive three-pointer with a minute left to play. The Hamburg team, which had suffered five consecutive losses, showed resilience and character in their victory. Jahvon Blair made his debut for Hamburg, scoring 11 points, 4 rebounds, 6 assists, and 2 steals. Jena's London Perrantes had 13 points and 8 assists, but his team's 18 turnovers ultimately proved costly. The win moves Hamburg out of the relegation zone, while Jena suffered its fourth consecutive loss.

*Box score unavailable.*

## European Cups

### German Teams Face Crucial EuroCup and Champions League Matches

The new European week in basketball begins on Tuesday with three German teams in action in the BKT EuroCup and the Basketball Champions League. RASTA Vechta faces Hapoel Holon in the Champions League, while Rostock Seawolves play Cedevita Ljubljana in the EuroCup. ALBA Berlin has a crucial match against Surne Bilbao in the Champions League, where a win would practically secure the group lead. For Rostock, a win against Ljubljana is a must in their own hall, as they have only two wins so far in the EuroCup. Vechta's match against Holon is their last chance to stay in the group, while Holon can secure their spot in the Play-Ins with a win.

### Rostock Seawolves face Slovenian record champions Cedevita Olimpija Ljubljana

The Rostock Seawolves will host Cedevita Olimpija Ljubljana in the BKT EuroCup on Tuesday at 20:00. The match will be broadcast live on MagentaSport from 19:50. The Seawolves are currently sixth in Group A with a 2-4 record, and a win could move them up the standings. Cedevita Olimpija Ljubljana, a traditional club from Slovenia, has a rich history, dating back to 1946. They have won several titles, including the Eurocup in 1994 and a third-place finish in the EuroLeague Final Four in 1997. The team has been dominant in Slovenia, winning six consecutive national championships and 23 titles overall. Key players for Cedevita include Anthony Cowan Jr., Rihards Lomazs, and Matthew Hurt. The Seawolves will be without Owen Klassen, who is recovering from a knee injury and is expected to return in December.

### Elsen Unternehmensgruppe becomes new partner of VET-Concept Gladiators Trier

The ELSEN Unternehmensgruppe has become the new partner of the VET-Concept Gladiators Trier, a professional basketball team in the easyCredit BBL. The company, which is based in Wittlich and has international operations, will support the team in the BBL and the FIBA Europe Cup. With over 1,300 employees and operations at 30 locations across Europe, the ELSEN Logistikgruppe is one of the largest regional employers in the logistics industry. The company has a long history, dating back to 1870, and has been a major player in the regional and international logistics industry. The partnership is seen as a boost for the team, with the ELSEN Unternehmensgruppe bringing its expertise and network to the table. The team's Geschäftsführer, Florian Hosseini, expressed his gratitude for the partnership, stating that it is a significant development for the team. The partnership is set to begin this season, with the team looking forward to a successful campaign.

## Around the League

### Alba Berlin Teams Suffer Defeats in Various Leagues

Alba Berlin's youth teams suffered losses in the WNBL and JBBL. In the WNBL, Alba Berlin was defeated 82-75 by SG Bernau-Berlin-Nord, with Anastazja Koren scoring 16 points, 8 rebounds, and 5 steals. In the JBBL, Alba Berlin lost 79-82 to Rendsburg, with Konrad Terwey scoring 23 points and 13 rebounds. Meanwhile, Alba Berlin's partner team LOK Bernau achieved a historic 133-65 win in the ProB league, securing the highest regular season win in ProB history. TuS Lichterfelde, another Alba Berlin partner team, lost 71-83 to WINGS Leverkusen in the 2nd DBBL Nord.

### Phoenix Hagen Women's Team Wins Away Game Against Hamburg Towers

Phoenix-TSV Hagen 1860's women's team secured their fourth win in four games with a 65-87 victory over Hamburg Towers on November 8, 2026. The game was played at the Margit-Zinke-Halle in Hamburg, and the visitors from Hagen struggled in the first quarter, losing it 18-17. However, they turned the game around in the subsequent quarters, with their defense improving significantly. The Hagen duo of Darina Zraychenko and Emma Huppertz led the offense, with Huppertz dominating in the paint and Zraychenko finding ways to score and set up Huppertz. Katharina Welzel also found her rhythm in the second half, while rookie Lucy Melchior contributed with a double-double, including 12 points, 12 rebounds, 3 assists, and 6 steals. The win marked a successful away game for the Hagen team, who were able to overcome their physical and experienced opponents.

### Seawolves Academy suffer heavy defeat in ProB, JBBL team wins in JBBL

The Seawolves Academy suffered a 65:133 defeat in the BARMER 2. Basketball Bundesliga ProB Nord against LOK Bernau on November 7. The home team took control of the game after the initial minutes, leading to a large margin. Coach Domenik Reinboth stated that his team was not well-prepared and struggled to counter the opponent's aggression and physicality. In a separate match, the Rostock U16 team, also known as the Seawolves, won 81:67 against the Sartorius Youngsters from Göttingen in the JBBL. Tom Steffen led the team with 19 points, and three other players scored in double digits. The Rostock U16 team will face the Bramfelder SV on November 15 and the BG Braunschweig on November 16 in the ProB.

### BonnRhöndorf starts NBBL season with two wins, one narrow loss

The Telekom Baskets Bonn youth teams, BonnRhöndorf and Baskets Bonn/Köln RAG, began their NBBL and JBBL seasons with a successful start. BonnRhöndorf won both their U19 and U16 league games, defeating Bayer Giants Leverkusen 94:63 and VR-Bank Würzburg Baskets Akademie 106:63 respectively. Baskets Bonn/Köln RAG, however, lost to UBC Münster in a dramatic game that went into two overtime periods, finishing 90:92. BonnRhöndorf also won their third game against Leverkusen, this time with a more convincing 94:63 score. Head coach Tom Becker praised his team's performance, saying it was their best against Leverkusen so far, both offensively and defensively.

### Bamberg Baskets Extend Winning Streak to Five Games

Medikamente per Klick Bamberg Baskets secured their fifth consecutive win in the Toyota 2. Damen Basketball Bundesliga, defeating TSV 1880 Wasserburg 81-70 on October 6. The team, led by Head Coach Samuel Gloser, is now tied with USC BasCats Heidelberg at the top of the table with a 5-1 record. Elise Tweedie was named player of the game, recording her fourth double-double of the season with 24 points and 12 rebounds. Jackie Grisdale also contributed 24 points, while Emelie Dohrmann scored 18 points and dished out 6 assists. Abby Ray led Wasserburg with 25 points, but the visitors' 32 points from fast breaks were a concern for Gloser.

### Hamburg Towers bounce back with 77:74 win over Friedenau TSC

The Hamburg Towers' JBBL team secured a 77:74 home win over Friedenau TSC, coming from behind after a difficult start. Despite struggling to find their rhythm offensively in the second half, the Towers held on for the victory. Head Coach Marian Schick praised his team's resilience, saying they had shown great moral after falling behind. The team had previously struggled to maintain momentum in games, and Schick acknowledged that they would need to work on this aspect. The win was a welcome boost for the Towers, who had also been in action in the NBBL and WNBL competitions, with mixed results.
